plugins.name: wisdom-council-layer
plugins.description: Wisdom Council Layer (知恵の評議会) — a multi-agent AI value evaluation system that discovers meaningful value beyond generic outputs through diverse perspectives: originality, anti-generic filter, aesthetics, emotion, future potential, business, science, philosophy, meaning, and quality. Available in English (default), Japanese, and Chinese (Simplified).
